mission.requirement_text:
# RTS 2024/1774 — article 16 : acquisition, développement et maintenance des systèmes TIC
Source : règlement délégué (UE) 2024/1774, article 16 « ICT systems acquisition, development, and maintenance ». Extraits du texte officiel anglais ; vérifier sur EUR-Lex.

Article 16(1): financial entities shall develop, document and implement a policy governing the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems. That policy shall:
(a) identify security practices and methodologies relating to the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems;
(c) specify measures to mitigate the risk of unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation of the ICT systems during development, maintenance, and deployment.
Article 16(2): financial entities shall develop, document, and implement an ICT systems' acquisition, development, and maintenance procedure for the testing and approval of all ICT systems prior to their use and after maintenance.
Article 16(3): the procedure shall contain source code reviews covering both static and dynamic testing, including security testing for internet-exposed systems and applications. Financial entities shall:
(a) identify and analyse vulnerabilities and anomalies in the source code;
(b) adopt an action plan to address those vulnerabilities and anomalies;
(c) monitor the implementation of that action plan.
Article 16(4): the procedure shall contain security testing of software packages no later than at the integration phase.
Article 16(5): the procedure shall provide that:
(a) non-production environments only store anonymised, pseudonymised, or randomised production data;
(b) financial entities are to protect the integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.
Article 16(7): the procedure shall include controls to protect the integrity of source code of ICT systems that are developed in-house or by an ICT third-party service provider.
Article 16(8): proprietary software and, where feasible, the source code provided by ICT third-party service providers, as well as source code coming from open-source projects, are to be analysed and tested in accordance with paragraph 3 prior to their deployment in the production environment.


# Politique interne PDS-2 (Banque Kerlann, fictive) — développement sécurisé
Déclinaison interne de DORA 9(3), du RTS 2024/1774 articles 6, 7, 12 et 16 pour le code applicatif. Elle fixe les règles
précises que les textes réglementaires ne donnent pas.

| Règle | Exigence | Criticité | Fondement |
|---|---|---|---|
| PDS-2.1 | Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement. | Critique | RTS 7(2) |
| PDS-2.2 | Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit). | Élevée | DORA 9(3)(a) ; RTS 6(2)(a) |
| PDS-2.3 | Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité. | Élevée | RTS 6(3) et 6(4) |
| PDS-2.4 | La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification. | Moyenne | RTS 16(3) |
| PDS-2.5 | Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent). | Moyenne | RTS 16(4) et 16(8) |
| PDS-2.6 | Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné. | Élevée | RTS 16(5)(a) |
| PDS-2.7 | Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application. | Moyenne | RTS 12(2)(c)(i) |

## Délais de remédiation
Critique : 30 jours · Élevée : 90 jours · Moyenne : 180 jours · Faible : 365 jours.

control.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned config
control.objective: Verify no clear-text passwords, keys or tokens are versioned.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/config.py and other app/ files, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(password|passwd|secret|api_key|token)\s*=\s*['"]. Verify secrets are loaded via os.environ, os.getenv or vault client.
control.expected: Zero matches for hardcoded secret assignments; secrets only via vault or environment variables.
control.risk: Hardcoded secrets enable credential theft and unauthorized access.
control.recommendation: Remove clear-text secrets and load them from vault or environment variables.
control.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

control.objective: Verify no outbound call disables TLS certificate verification.

control.recommendation: Remove verify=False and enforce TLS certificate verification.

before.detail: Search found 1 matches for verify=False and 0 matches for verify=0.

inspection.comment: Line 18 in app/payments.py shows verify=False, matching the automated test failure.

control.title: Password hashing uses approved algorithm
control.objective: Verify passwords are hashed only with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2 and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py to review password hashing implementation.
control.expected: Password hashing uses only argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.

control.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

control.title: MD5 and SHA-1 banned for security use
control.objective: Verify MD5 and SHA-1 are not used for security purposes.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=\bmd5\b|\bsha1\b|hashlib\.md5|hashlib\.sha1|hashlib\.sha_1 and review matches in GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py.

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document and implement a policy governing the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems.
requirements.summary: Entities must have a documented policy for ICT acquisition, development and maintenance.
requirements.why: Policy existence and documentation cannot be verified through read-only code access.

requirements.quote: identify security practices and methodologies relating to the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems;
requirements.summary: The policy must identify security practices and methodologies.
requirements.why: Policy content requires document review and is not visible in source code.

requirements.quote: specify measures to mitigate the risk of unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation of the ICT systems during development, maintenance, and deployment.
requirements.summary: The policy must specify measures against alteration or manipulation during development.
requirements.why: Mitigation measures in process require document review, not code search.

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document, and implement an ICT systems' acquisition, development, and maintenance procedure for the testing and approval of all ICT systems prior to their use and after maintenance.
requirements.summary: Entities must have a procedure for testing and approval before use and after maintenance.
requirements.why: Procedure existence and approval workflow require document review.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain source code reviews covering both static and dynamic testing, including security testing for internet-exposed systems and applications.
requirements.summary: The procedure must include source code reviews with static and dynamic testing.
requirements.why: Static testing obligation is verifiable in CI via the repository interface and is covered by policy control.

requirements.quote: identify and analyse vulnerabilities and anomalies in the source code;
requirements.summary: Vulnerabilities and anomalies in source code must be identified and analysed.
requirements.why: Identification reports and analysis require document review beyond code search.

requirements.quote: adopt an action plan to address those vulnerabilities and anomalies;
requirements.summary: An action plan must be adopted to address vulnerabilities.
requirements.why: Action plan existence requires document review, not repository reads.

requirements.quote: monitor the implementation of that action plan.
requirements.summary: Implementation of the action plan must be monitored.
requirements.why: Monitoring evidence requires tracking documents, not code alone.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain security testing of software packages no later than at the integration phase.
requirements.summary: Security testing of software packages must occur no later than integration.
requirements.why: Integration-phase package auditing is verifiable in CI and dependencies via the repository interface.

requirements.quote: non-production environments only store anonymised, pseudonymised, or randomised production data;

requirements.quote: financial entities are to protect the integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.

requirements.why: Integrity controls like branch protection and signing need document review, interface has no history.

requirements.quote: proprietary software and, where feasible, the source code provided by ICT third-party service providers, as well as source code coming from open-source projects, are to be analysed and tested in accordance with paragraph 3 prior to their deployment in the production environment.
